summary: Frontend-only regression for Compliance mobile drawer, LandscapePrompt banners on Billing/Reports/Analytics/Report-builder, plus regression of the pre-existing Settings mobile drawer and app-nav-mobile shell drawer. Logged in as founder@audinexa.com at 390x844 (mobile) and 1440x900 (desktop). All new mobile drawer flows, backdrop/close/auto-close behaviours, LandscapePrompt visibility rules, dismiss persistence via localStorage, and desktop hiding rules PASS. BuilderSidebar responsive classes verified via source (md:hidden pill + hidden md:block aside + md:hidden drawer). No test IDs were broken; regression on Settings drawer and app-nav-mobile is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: CompliancePolicyPack.jsx: mobile drawer scopes policy buttons via [data-testid^=policy-] but PolicyStatusIcon also uses testids policy-status-signed / policy-status-unsigned / policy-status-superseded — technically prefixed the same way. Not breaking (list-item buttons remain uniquely policy-<id>) but consider a distinct prefix (e.g. policy-item-<id>) to avoid future selector ambiguity.
LandscapePrompt only re-evaluates on resize/orientationchange — SSR-safe but relies on window at first paint; fine for CRA. No action needed.
BuilderSidebar sidebarInner is a closure over many parent props; recreated every render — could be memoised, but not a correctness bug.
test_credentials: founder@audinexa.com / founder123 (only working login; founder role, so /ha/analytics returns role-guard denial rather than the OwnerAnalyticsPage — LandscapePrompt visibility at that route could not be UI-verified with this login. Code inspection confirms <LandscapePrompt testid="analytics-landscape" /> is rendered inside OwnerAnalyticsPage at line 108.)
